compute_node_classification_loss: compute the node classification loss and accuracy statistics from logits and a batch of node labels
extract_predictions_from_logits: extract node indices, predictions, labels, and logits from model output and a data batch
calculate_topk_accuracy: calculate the top-k accuracy count by comparing predicted rankings against true labels with a valid mask
ensemble_model_predictions: ensemble multiple model predictions by averaging their softmax probabilities and returning combined predictions
compute_bgrl_loss: compute the Barlow Twins-style BGRL contrastive loss between online predictions and target projections
